text.description_html:
OMN-085/ACN2-US3, Solid Brass Acorn Finial

An easy screw-on installation makes this hinge finial an effortless way to add the finishes details that help turn a house into a beautiful home. The Acorn finial is made of durable solid brass so you know it will last though years of continuous use.

Hinge Finials (tips) are packaged and sold by the pair.

Specifications of the Omnia Acorn Tip Finial:

  • Height: 3/4"
  • Maximum Diameter: 1/2"
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Easy screw-on installation
  • Sold in pairs
